pages.coverage: Full folio6 and long targets through wrapped reads: fourteen claimed letters versus thirteen listed; alif, numbers/letters/utterances/actions and power honorific; timing/discipline/talismans; dal4 and three 4×4 formulations; Monday birth/commission/death and EACH Prophet blessing; Moon3degrees Taurus/no malefics/hour/purification/2prayerunits/100recitations/parchment; each carrying benefit, prisoner, banner enemies/disputant; four elements/humors in order; four/not-raba; Names al-Daim/al-Wadud and God Most High, Ahmad/Muhammad, permanence explanation; Throne/firstworld/spirits/intellects/mercy; God Most High and Harithah pleasure prayer; every dialogue actor, three worldly pairs and three destinations; spirits/purity/prostration; wudd/hubb repetitions, al-shaqq/ahabb wording, shaghaf/fuad, three cavities and unfinished ending. No supplied diagram: none invented.

أربعة لا ربعة has an uncertain second term; ربعة is not securely ربع (quarter).
The transition from dal/al-Daim to Ahmad/Muhammad and the subsequent permanence clause is grammatically incomplete; preserve these named items but do not invent a causal explanation.
الشّق and أحب باطن العشق are problematic in the love-term passage. Keep the actual al-shaqq reading and readable heart/shaghaf/fuad content; never silently substitute remembered al-ishq or al-hubb.
The page ends at محل (place). Do not complete the next-page referent.
